notes.title: Восхитительное спасение маяка: Обзор Monument Valley 3
notes.content: После полугодовой эксклюзивности в стане Netflix третья часть Monument Valley добралась до ПК и консолей. И если оригинальная игра по-хорошему взорвала мир мобильного гейминга в 2014 году, то к триквелу разработчики растеряли элемент шокирующей инновации. Впрочем, проект все ещё вызывает положительные эмоции.

notes.title: Building The Impossible: The Making of Monument Valley 3
notes.content:
[h2][b]Building the Impossible - The Making of Monument Valley 3[/b][/h2][previewyoutube="pjsLWH0mCVk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We’re so excited to share this new documentary about the making of Monument Valley 3 with our fans. Learn about how we built the game, the inspirations behind our creative vision and the impact we hope the game will have on the world![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Monument Valley 3 has been out for over a week now, and we've been delighted with the response from our players so far. Thank you all so much for playing and joining us on Noor's voyage.

We can't wait to show you what's in store for The Garden of Life later this year.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Our Commitment to Funding Flood Relief Programmes[/b][/p][p]As showcased in our documentary, we’ve made a commitment to donate 3% of all profits generated by Monument Valley 3 to flood relief programmes by the IFRC. By purchasing and playing Monument Valley 3, you’re helping communities affected by devastating floods around the world.[/p][p][/p][p]Find out more about our partnership with IFRC here: [/p][p][url="https://ustwogames.co.uk/news/ustwo-games-x-ifrc/"]https://ustwogames.co.uk/news/ustwo-games-x-ifrc/[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Many thanks for your continued support[/p][p][/p][p]Your friends,[/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: Monument Valley 3 is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[h2][b]Monument Valley 3 is officially OUT NOW on Steam![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink][i]Launch discount of 10% available until 5th August 2025.[/i]
[/p][p]Experience Monument Valley 3 with cinematic widescreen, stunning art design and impossible landscapes, all fully playable with gamepad or keyboard and mouse.
[/p][p]Noor must seek out a new source of light before darkness overtakes her world. Guide her through sprawling cities, coastal harbours, and abstract, ethereal realms.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]More content planned for Monument Valley 3, later this year[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558643/a0f6e3b9f553b782be78f75fb96e2267384ff770.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re excited to let you know that we will be releasing more content for Monument Valley 3 later this year. We will release this content - The Garden of Life - [b]free for all players[/b]. [/p][p]More information to be shared with you soon![/p][p][/p][h2][b]3% of Profits Will Go to Flood Relief Programmes[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558643/96a2068a0f005e2b3518cadcd814569cb4bb3450.png"][/img][/p][p]As a reminder, 3% of all profits generated by Monument Valley 3 will be donated to flood relief programmes by the IFRC. [/p][p]As the rainy season begins in places such as South America and devastating floods continue to impact communities, we’re deeply grateful to our players - your support is helping deliver clean water, sanitation and support to families in need. Thank you.
[/p][p]Your friends,[/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: A Behind-the-Scenes look at Monument Valley 3
notes.content: [p]We’re so excited to share a small teaser of this new upcoming documentary about the making of [b]Monument Valley 3[/b] with you.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="7RgDSO-i1gI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The full documentary will be released very soon, and includes insight into how we built the game, the inspirations behind our creative vision and the impact we hope the game will have on the world![/p][p]We hope you enjoy this little sneak-peek at what the full documentary will entail.[/p][p]As a reminder, Monument Valley 3 will be releasing on Steam just next week on July 22nd![/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist using the link below:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you again for all your support during this journey.[/p][p]Your friends, [/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: Stream the Monument Valley 3 Soundtrack Now
notes.content:
[p]We’re delighted to share that the official Monument Valley 3 digital soundtrack is now available to stream on [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/1O8s3BqsAmrczfIkcWCDkl?si=TdUX6f1kTmSB4kdd_9DFYQ"]Spotify[/url], [url="https://music.apple.com/us/album/monument-valley-3-original-game-soundtrack/1816219122"]Apple Music[/url], [url="https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=R9KeQfaXFqo&list=OLAK5uy_lWAsA69NFUfog1nk28tZPoSCdow5OC120"]YouTube Music[/url] and more.[/p][p][/p][p]For Monument Valley 3, we didn’t just see game audio as a backdrop, but as an integral and emotionally resonant part of the player experience. Todd Baker and Lucie Treacher have created this beautiful, dynamic soundscape that we’re so excited to share with you. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="R9KeQfaXFqo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Whether you’re wanting to revisit your experience of playing Monument Valley 3, or simply looking for a moment of calm in your day, we hope this music offers you a place to pause, reflect and breathe. [/p][p]For those that would like to own the soundtrack, [b]it will also be available here on Steam too[/b] when the full game releases on 22nd July. [/p][p]If you haven’t done so already, wishlisting Monument Valley 3 is the best way to support us and stay updated and across all our upcoming announcements as we prepare for launch.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink]Thank you for your continued support. We still have some more exciting announcements to share ahead of release. We will be in touch soon.
[/p][p]Your friends,[/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: A Sneak Peek into Monument Valley 3 – Watch the Wholesome Direct Reveal!
notes.content:
[p]We’re thrilled to share that Monument Valley 3 was recently featured as part of this year’s Wholesome Direct showcase.[/p][p]
Every year, the Wholesome Direct celebrates cozy games that bring a sense of calm, beauty and joy to all their players. We couldn’t be happier to be featured alongside so many brilliant games, studios and creators making such thoughtful and uplifting experiences. [/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t had the chance to catch our little feature yet, you can find it here as part of the Wholesome Direct showcase: [/p][previewyoutube="HiJI8g9j56c;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Monument Valley 3 releases on Steam very soon (July 22nd!), and we’re so grateful for your support so far. All the excitement we see in comments, on our social channels like [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@ustwo.games"]TikTok[/url] and [url="https://www.instagram.com/ustwogames/"]Instagram[/url], means everything to us. We can’t wait for you to join us on Noor’s journey.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t done so already, wishlisting Monument Valley 3 is the best way to support us and stay updated and across all our upcoming announcements as we prepare for launch. We have some very exciting new things to announce over the coming few weeks, and we wouldn’t want you to miss them.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink]Also, lots of you seemed to enjoy trying our Monument Valley 3 demo that was made available for Steam Next Fest - so we’ve decided to keep it available! Check it out on the store page above.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of our journey so far. We can’t wait to share more soon. [/p][p][/p][p]Your friends,[/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: Monument Valley 3 coming to Steam July 22nd – Play the demo now!
notes.content:
[p]Revealed during the recent Wholesome Direct livestream at Summer Game Fest, this next chapter in the beloved Monument Valley series brings our most expansive and emotional puzzle adventure to PC – fully optimised for keyboard & mouse or controller, and complete with our first major seasonal update, The Garden of Life.
 
But you don’t have to wait until July to begin your journey: A playable demo is now available to mark [b]Steam Next Fest (June 9–16)![/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558643/8b0fe92b4f2d72f01f3d6637b1175ce1a0a773b6.gif"][/img]

[b]Step into Noor’s world, solve your first impossible puzzles, and get a taste of the breathtaking visuals, serene soundscapes and mind-bending exploration that define Monument Valley 3.[/b] [b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]What to Expect:[/b]  [/p][list][*][p] A cinematic adventure with stunning, surreal architecture
[/p][/*][*][p] Noor’s biggest journey yet through harbours, cities, and flood-altered realms
[/p][/*][*][p] New mechanics and puzzles in every chapter
[/p][/*][*][p] Sail across surreal waters in a Monument Valley first
[/p][/*][*][p] Seasonal updates starting with The Garden of Life, with more to come post-launch

[b]Plus, later this summer we’ll be sharing:[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]  A behind-the-scenes Making Of documentary [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p] The official soundtrack (digital and vinyl)
[/p][/*][/list][p]As part of our commitment to real-world impact, 3% of profits from Monument Valley 3 are being donated to Flood Relief via our partnership with the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC). So far, players have helped us raise $80,000 – thank you, and find out more about our impact journey here https://ustwogames.co.uk/mv3-impact .   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558643/7624b006e39292d96d9565fcc3a716d6fd628f25.gif"][/img][/p][p]

Wishlisting helps us a ton, so if you haven’t already, hit that star and let Noor’s journey begin!

notes.title: Play Monument Valley 3 with the Devs
notes.content:
[h3][b]Discover the first 4 chapters of Monument Valley 3 with this exclusive play through from the developers.[/b][/h3]

Join Lili and Holly from the art team as they play through the first four chapters of Monument Valley 3 live!

They’ll chat about the creative process, share a few behind-the-scenes stories, and show how some of our favourite moments came to life.

Come hang out, ask questions, and get an early look at the world of MV3 — straight from the people who helped build it.

🧡 [b]Don’t forget to wishlist Monument Valley 3 to follow the journey and be first to know when it launches![/b]
